name: theDotNetWay
line: Campfire in F#, the way a .NET team would write it
question: What if the rewrite leaned on the framework for everything, and came out smaller than the Rust port?
body: A fork of the F# port that swapped each hand-written layer for the standard .NET piece, one layer at a time behind a pixel-parity gate: Kestrel and ASP.NET Core middleware, EF Core with Dapper on the hot reads, Falco.Markup views, AngleSharp, HybridCache. Smaller than Rust and several times Rails on Basecamp's harness; Rust, C and onCrack are still faster.
alt: theDotNetWay: hand-written layers swapped for .NET framework pieces, code shrinking from 39.2 to 26.5 KLOC
